evals.prompt: We have an approved prop sheet for the Lumo travel mug (elements/lumo-mug/prop_lumo-mug_sheet_v02.png) and the brand kit's primary color #2E6FD8. Give me a color-pop product shot for a 4:5 feed ad. The mug's wordmark must be readable.
evals.expected_output: A plate + composite plan: a Seedream I2I prompt for an empty brand-blue plate with the product slot and shadow area described, plus a deterministic composite of the authorized packshot, three samples, and QA including a target-color measurement.
expectations: Chooses the plate + composite route because the wordmark must be legible, and does not ask Seedream to render the wordmark.
Binds the approved reference as @Image 1 and uses it only for scale and light direction in the plate prompt.
States the backdrop as a color name plus hex #2E6FD8 and does not invent other brand colors.
Uses 4:5 sizing within the Seedream pixel range and defaults to three samples.
Plans QA with white_background_check.py using --target '#2E6FD8' and a check that product colors did not shift.
Asks for an authorized alpha packshot if none exists rather than generating the label.

evals.prompt: Make a studio-white marketplace main image for our new kettle. We don't have any photos or a prop sheet yet, just the product name.
evals.expected_output: A stop: no prompt is written without an approved product reference; the response asks for an authorized packshot or a prop sheet first and explains the composite route once one exists.
expectations: Refuses to write a Text-to-Image product shot from the name alone.
Asks for an authorized packshot or an approved product reference and names the prop-sheet route as an alternative.
Notes that a clean alpha packshot on #FFFFFF can be composited deterministically without generation.
Says the target marketplace's current image rules must be re-verified before delivery and does not quote them as verified.

evals.prompt: Here are three studio-white samples. The checker says sample t02 has matching_share 0.94 and mean_border_rgb [238, 238, 238]; t01 passes at 0.998 but the label reads 'Lumo Traval Mug'. t03 passes and the label is turned away. Which one do we pick for the marketplace?
evals.expected_output: t02 fails the white-background check (light gray backdrop); t01 fails label legibility because readable text differs from the reference; t03 passes with a note if the brief accepts a turned label. If the label must be readable, re-plan as a composite.
expectations: Fails t02 on the white-background check and identifies the gray backdrop from the mean border color.
Fails t01 because readable text differs from the reference, even though the background passes.
Passes t03 only as pass-noted, conditional on the brief accepting an unreadable label.
Does not suggest re-prompting Seedream to fix the misspelled label; proposes a deterministic composite instead.
Leaves the final selection to the project approval mode rather than declaring it approved.

evals.prompt: Write an in-use shot of our cleaning spray showing the stain completely disappearing from a white sofa in one spray.
evals.expected_output: An in-use prompt limited to the supported operation; the stain-removal result is treated as a claim requiring a supported fact before it is pictured.
expectations: Asks whether a supported fact backs the one-spray stain removal result before picturing it.
Offers an in-use prompt showing the observable operation (spraying the fabric) without an unsupported before/after result.
Binds the product reference as @Image 1 and does not invent label text.
Takes the setting and any people from the brief rather than assuming a market or culture.

evals.prompt: Run the white background check on product_lumo-mug_studio-white_t01_v01.jpg.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the checker reads 8-bit RGB or RGBA PNG only, asks for or converts to a PNG copy, and explains exit codes and the re-verification of marketplace rules.
expectations: States that JPEG input is unsupported and a PNG conversion is needed before the check.
Explains the exit codes: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 unreadable or unsupported.
Notes that the check measures only the border and visual inspection is still required.
